scenes.say: Picture this. Your solar quote includes a twelve thousand dollar battery.
If your utility has full retail net metering, solar without a battery usually pays back fastest.

lines: a battery can save a lot.
scenes.say: Under net billing or time-of-use rates, a battery can add real savings by shifting solar to the evening.
And if outages are frequent or costly for you, backup value alone can justify one.
Not sure yet? Choose battery-ready equipment and add storage later.
Still deciding? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
